text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as Symboli Rudolf and I<n>are making
our way through the<n>shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's happening over there?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New
Year's raffle! This year's<n>grand-prize is a hot
spring vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your<n>luck?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It looks like a raffle, Trainer. Shall we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What, for me to be intrigued? It just<n>so happens
that I have a ticket.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian gave it to me. I recall she said<n>she "needed
somebody to dump it<n>on."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But even if she hadn't, I am<n>interested in the raffle
for its own<n>sake.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To entrust one's fate to chance and<n>receive a
commensurate prize in<n>return...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is almost like a test of one's true<n>worth... I could
hardly call myself<n>Emperor if I did not win
something<n>suitably extravagant.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is to say, I will be satisfied with<n>nothing
less than the grand-prize: the<n>hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How about it? Shall we prove our<n>worth?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We glance at one another, nod, and<n>then turn the
handle together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a
grand-prize winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for
your hot spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We have bested luck today, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'm rather pleased.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah, do I not look it? I promise you, I<n>am more
enthusiastic than you might<n>think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But this now leaves me with a<n>quandary.
choice_data_list: Are you not a fan of hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Au contraire. I love nothing more than<n>relaxing in
the hot water as I soak in<n>the beauty of nature.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... I do not believe I am yet<n>worthy of
such luxuries.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So here. The ticket is yours.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed I am. Save it until I have<n>earned the holiday.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As for when that is, I leave it to your<n>discretion. I
know that you will judge<n>me fair and true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha... There's no need to feel too<n>concerned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will work all the harder in anticipation<n>of our
excursion together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And when that day comes, I will<n>celebrate as
much as anybody else.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The ticket feels heavy in my hand, but<n>with that
responsibility comes the<n>promise of a fun
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The name seems apt. This patty is<n>certainly
weighty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long time since I have<n>seen a meal so
lavish.
choice_data_list: You don't normally eat this kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not often, no.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I usually opt for plain cuts of steak<n>when I feel like
meat, due to its low<n>fat content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are what you eat, as they say.<n>Although I
doubt you of all people<n>need reminding of that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is a worthy prize. It would be<n>a waste not
to make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It would go perfect with some melted<n>cheese, a
parsley garnish, and... Oh!<n>How about one of those
miniature<n>flags?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But of course. When receiving a gift<n>so fine, it is
one's duty to enjoy it to<n>the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We spend a good long while<n>discussing how best
to decorate the<n>patty.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky
day! You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, splendid. These will prove to be<n>useful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The student council was just<n>planning an event to
raise the<n>students' spirits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With this many carrots, I daresay we<n>can offer a
special meal for that day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll contact the cafeteria and see what<n>they can do
on short notice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you could help? I know—why<n>don't you
be my royal taster?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll warn you, this is an important<n>duty. I trust
you'll not shirk it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I earned a<n>prestigious position in
the Emperor's<n>court.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the
third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Answer me this, Trainer. What is the<n>most notable
nutritional aspect of a<n>carrot?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. The body converts carotene<n>to vitamin
A, which maintains the<n>health of skin and bodily
membranes.<n>It also has other benefits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So how would you prepare a carrot to<n>best aid
carotene absorption?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to know what dish would<n>make
optimal use of this carrot.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, we end up<n>embroiled in a fierce
debate over how<n>to bring out the best qualities of
carrots.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank
one! Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tissues...
choice_data_list: Shame we missed out on the big prizes.
Shame we missed out on the big prizes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no need to feel down.<n>Testing one's
luck would be no fun<n>without the risk of failure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I happen to be running low<n>on tissues.
This has saved me the<n>trouble of having to buy
more.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
True to form, the Emperor takes the
disappointment in stride without a<n>word of
complaint.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, do you have any other<n>engagements
today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have some time before my next<n>appointment.
Seeing as we're<n>nearby, I thought we might—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt, bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, but it seems I'm out of<n>time. I must
return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It might be my imagination, but<n>Symboli Rudolf
looks a little dejected<n>as she walks away.
